podcast.title: Zack de la Rocha's Project
podcast.body: Following his departure from Rage Against the Machine, Zack de la Rocha pursued various solo endeavors and collaborations, including a project named One Day as a Lion. This project has since received attention, indicating de la Rocha's continued musical output beyond his work with Rage. "Zach also has a little project called One Day as a Lion that has received some attention."
